operatorProperties.code:
def process(new_england_identity_theft) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = new_england_identity_theft.copy()
    # Drop duplicates by metro_area (same MSA may appear in multiple state files)
    df_unique = df.drop_duplicates(subset=['metro_area'])
    # Sort by reports descending and get top 5
    top5 = df_unique.nlargest(5, 'reports')[['metro_area', 'reports']].reset_index(drop=True)
    return top5

operators.customDisplayName: Get top 5 distinct Metropolitan Statistical Areas in New England by number of Identity Theft reports in 2024. Deduplicates by metro_area name first, then sorts by reports descending.
